name: Warung Luminescence → Flip of the Coin — v1 (Bass EQ Handoff)
description: Both tracks at 122 BPM. Keys: 3A → 4A (perfect Camelot neighbor). Warung's melody dies at ~bar 224, leaving kick/bass through bar 239. Flip starts with kick from bar 0 but almost no mids until bar 16. Overlap 24 bars (Warung 216-240, Flip 0-24). Bass EQ kills Flip's kick early, lets it enter as mids/highs texture, then bass ramps in as Warung fades. Warung's kick carries the rhythm until handoff.

tracks.name: Warung - Luminescence
tracks.notes: 8:00, 241 bars, 3A (Bb minor). Melody dies ~bar 224, kick/bass persists to 239, silence at 240.

tracks.name: Flip of the Coin (Extended Mix)
tracks.notes: 6:39, 200 bars, 4A (F minor). Kick from bar 0, mids build at 8, fuller at 16, DROP at 24.

transitions.notes: v1: 24-bar overlap. Warung bars 216-240 (bars 216-224 have melody, 224+ kick-only). Flip bars 0-24 (sparse intro → DROP). Bass EQ on Flip: kick killed at start, ramps to full. Crossover at 200Hz (catch kick fundamental, spare upper harmonics). Flip enters as texture/mids only, Warung carries the groove. Automation pushes handoff toward bar 16-20 where Warung melody is gone and Flip is building.
